chunks: And ʿAlī عليه السلام said: “The last thing upon which I parted from the beloved of my heart صلى الله عليه وآله was that he said:
‘O ʿAlī, when you lead the salat, then lead the prayer of the weakest of those behind you, and do not appoint a muʾadhdhin who takes payment for his adhan.’

key_terms.أَجْرًا: payment or wage taken in return
key_terms.أَضْعَفِ: the weakest or least able person to be considered
key_terms.صَلَاةَ: the salat being offered in congregation
key_terms.صَلَّيْتَ: you performed or led the salat
key_terms.فَصَلِّ: then perform or lead the prayer
key_terms.مُؤَذِّنًا: a caller who gives the adhan

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم instruct Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام about leading salat and appointing a muʾadhdhin?
ai.summary: This hadith records a final instruction conveyed by the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام regarding communal salat and the adhan. It emphasizes consideration for the weakest worshippers in congregational prayer and discourages appointing a muʾadhdhin who takes wages for the adhan.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.870 - Imam Ali (as) said:
"The last thing my beloved (the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said to me before parting was:
'O’ Ali, when you lead the prayer, lead it considering the weakest among those behind you. And do not appoint a mu'adhdhin who takes payment for his adhan.'"
